Frequently asked

Common questions about our industry expertise

Which industries does Sanctify specialise in?
Sanctify specialises in six core sectors in Goa: hospitality (hotels, resorts, restaurants), automotive (dealerships, rentals), real estate (villas, property developers), healthcare (clinics, dental practices), retail and luxury (boutiques, jewellery), and education (schools, academies). Each sector has a dedicated playbook built from 12+ years of local experience.
Do you only work with businesses in Goa?
While our deepest expertise is in Goa — where we understand the local market, seasonality and audience — we also serve brands across India, particularly those targeting Goan customers or the Goa tourism market from other states.
What makes your approach different from a generic digital agency?
We don't apply a one-size-fits-all template. Each industry has different buyer journeys, seasonality patterns and conversion triggers. A hotel needs direct bookings; a clinic needs trust and 'near me' visibility; a car dealership needs showroom footfall. Our strategies are built around these specific outcomes, not generic traffic metrics.
Can you show results for my specific industry?
Yes — open any sector page above for detailed case studies, the challenges we solve, services we deploy and FAQs specific to that industry. For example, our Mercedes-Benz and Hotel Supreme Grande case studies show real, measurable outcomes.
How does AI-search optimisation (GEO/AEO) help my business?
AI assistants like ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and Perplexity now answer customer questions directly. We optimise your content to be cited by these AI systems — ensuring your brand appears when potential customers ask questions related to your industry in Goa. This is the next frontier of visibility beyond traditional SEO.
